gen-gf-esteban-general-sans: Refined and bookish up top, Esteban has tall letters and moderate contrast, never stark, never flat. And General Sans follows with smooth sans-serif strokes that glide around every bend, so a long page would read easily.
gen-gf-finger-paint-rubik: Finger Paint is all fat, chunky strokes, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Rubik sits beneath in soft sans-serif letters, with big lowercase and round shapes that stay legible small, which tames the heading's heft.
gen-gf-fira-code-fs-supreme: Typewriter precision, wide-berth letters and tall lowercase in Fira Code, then Supreme underneath with crisp, heavy-looking sans-serif text. Long reading would feel firm.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, its c tips staying well apart from each other. Be Vietnam Pro follows in sans-serif form, with strokes like a bent steel rod and curve endings that keep their distance, a good foil for large headings.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-actor: Actor brings wide, barely curled s curves in a clean, modern sans-serif, set beneath Gabarito's expressive headings with their open-cut terminals. Strongest trait: shared openness.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sura: Gabarito draws with one nib, every curve as plain as a fixed-width stencil brush, its terminals cut open. And Sura answers in a traditional serif with subtle pen-like modulation in the bowls, so a long page would feel authoritative.
gen-gf-gajraj-one-fs-karma: Karma is a trustworthy serif whose terminals finish well clear of the stem, with a modulation that never snags the eye. Gajraj One, with fat black stems and shallow notches, belongs in big, short lines.
gen-gf-gideon-roman-fs-rowan: Rowan is literary and friendly, its generous curve openings and thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones. Strongest quality: Gideon Roman's caliper-like c leads with a boldness that its open neighbor softens.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-paquito: Confident and approachable, Paquito is a serif with almost no gap between x-height and caps beneath Goldman's widely set display letters. And its body text would read steadily across a long page, grounding the heading's bold, parenthesis-like rounds.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-strait: Wide-set and commanding, Goldman has rounds like open parentheses. Strait sits below with big round lowercase bowls, approachable and contemporary, and that shared roundness is what ties the two together.
